## Spec

A component writes this trait's fields under `spec.runtimeClass`.

```cue
// Name of an existing cluster RuntimeClass, e.g. "nvidia".
spec: runtimeClass: string & !=""
```

## Notes

The named RuntimeClass object is NOT created by this trait — it is cluster-level configuration that must already exist, and its `handler` must name a runtime the node's containerd knows.
